          {

          },

          },

          },

            "text": "    &lt;script&gt;",
            "lineNumber": 1420
          },
          {
            "text": "        let voosPorDia = {{ voos_json|safe }};",

          },
          {
            "text": "        const helicopteros = {{ helicopteros_json|safe }};",
            "lineNumber": 1422
          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "        const ROTAER_URL = {{ rotaer_url|tojson }};",
            "lineNumber": 1425
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 1426
          },
          {
            "text": "        ",
            "lineNumber": 1427
          },
          {
            "text": "        const TIPO_CORES = {",
            "lineNumber": 1428
          },
          {
            "text": "            'shuttleseat':     {cor: '#7c3aed', label: 'Shuttle Seat',      badge: 'SHUTTLE SEAT'},",
            "lineNumber": 1429
          },
          {
            "text": "            'shuttlefullcabin':{cor: '#6d28d9', label: 'Shuttle Full Cabin',badge: 'SHUTTLE FC'},",
            "lineNumber": 1430
          },
          {

          },

            "lineNumber": 1432
          },
          {
            "text": "        };",
            "lineNumber": 1433
          },
          {
            "text": "        function tipoInfo(tipo) {",
            "lineNumber": 1434
          },
          {
            "text": "            const k = (tipo || '').toLowerCase().replace(/[\\s_-]/g, '');",
            "lineNumber": 1435
          },
          {
            "text": "            return TIPO_CORES[k] || TIPO_CORES['charter'];",
            "lineNumber": 1436
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 1437
          },
          {
            "text": "        ",
            "lineNumber": 1438
          },
          {
            "text": "        let mesAtual = new Date().getMonth();",
            "lineNumber": 1439
          },
          {
            "text": "        let anoAtual = new Date().getFullYear();",
            "lineNumber": 1440
          },
          {
            "text": "        const hoje = new Date();",
            "lineNumber": 1441
          },
          {
            "text": "        let activeFilter = 'all';",
            "lineNumber": 1442
          },
          {
            "text": "        let currentModalDate = null;",
            "lineNumber": 1443
          },
          {
            "text": "        let weatherData = { base: {}, locations: {} };",
            "lineNumber": 1444
          },
          {
            "text": "        ",
            "lineNumber": 1445
          },
          {
            "text": "        const SEVERITY_COLORS = ['#22c55e', '#38bdf8', '#f59e0b', '#ef4444'];",
            "lineNumber": 1446
          },
          {
            "text": "        const SEVERITY_LABELS = ['Ideal p/ voo', 'Boas condições', 'Atenção', 'Desfavorável'];",
            "lineNumber": 1447
          },
          {
            "text": "        ",
            "lineNumber": 1448
          },
          {
            "text": "        function getWeatherForLocation(icao, dateStr) {",
            "lineNumber": 1449
          },
          {
            "text": "            return weatherData.locations[icao + '_' + dateStr] || null;",
            "lineNumber": 1450
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 1451
          },
          {
            "text": "        ",
            "lineNumber": 1452
          },
          {
            "text": "        function getWeatherForDate(dateStr) {",
            "lineNumber": 1453
          },
          {
            "text": "            return weatherData.base[dateStr] || null;",
            "lineNumber": 1454
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 1455
          },
          {
            "text": "        ",
            "lineNumber": 1456
          },
          {
            "text": "        async function fetchWeather() {",
            "lineNumber": 1457
          },
          {
            "text": "            try {",
            "lineNumber": 1458
          },
          {
            "text": "                const resp = await fetch('/api/weather');",
            "lineNumber": 1459
          },
          {
            "text": "                if (resp.ok) {",
            "lineNumber": 1460
          },
          {
            "text": "                    weatherData = await resp.json();",
            "lineNumber": 1461
          },
          {
            "text": "                    renderMeteoBelowMap();",
            "lineNumber": 1462
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 1463
          },
          {
            "text": "                }",
            "lineNumber": 1464
          },
          {
            "text": "            } catch(e) {",
            "lineNumber": 1465
          },
          {
            "text": "                console.warn('Weather fetch error:', e);",
            "lineNumber": 1466
          },
          {
            "text": "            }",
            "lineNumber": 1467
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 1468
          },
          {
            "text": "        ",
            "lineNumber": 1469
          },
          {
            "text": "        let avWeatherData = null;",
            "lineNumber": 1470
          },
          {
            "text": "        ",
            "lineNumber": 1471
          },
          {
            "text": "        async function fetchAviationWeather() {",
            "lineNumber": 1472
          },
          {
            "text": "            try {",
            "lineNumber": 1473
          },
          {
            "text": "                const resp = await fetch('/api/aviation-weather');",
            "lineNumber": 1474
          },
          {
            "text": "                if (resp.ok) {",
            "lineNumber": 1475
          },
          {
            "text": "                    avWeatherData = await resp.json();",
            "lineNumber": 1476
